$description: Shape and elevation. Elevation is tone; detachment is a boundary. There is no shadow token in this system by design (D-015).

xs.$description: checkbox, keyboard hint, badge on an icon

md.$description: button, input, select, menu item, tab

lg.$description: card, table container, modal, menu panel

width.$description: the only border weight in the system

style.$description: applied as outline on :focus-visible, never :focus, never box-shadow

d3.why: Composed into the focus outline shorthand rather than emitted on its own.

elevation.$description: Deliberately not a shadow ramp. Resting surfaces differ by tone and carry no border; floating layers sit at surface-raised and carry a 1px border-float at 3:1. A modal adds a scrim; nothing else does.

d3.why: Prose: this states the elevation rule, and there is no shadow ramp to emit (D-015).
